description: This file is a Next.js page component for rendering a detailed view of a book, including metadata generation, static parameter generation, and page rendering logic.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static route parameters for the first 50 books.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Fetches book data by ID to generate dynamic page metadata including title, description, and open graph tags.

methods.name: BookPage
methods.description: Default async React component that fetches a book by ID and renders the book detail page, handling not found cases.
